ValidationRule.description: Validates that charge type is populated for Cancelled Status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( blng__Status__c , 'Cancelled') , ISBLANK(TEXT( NSP_Chargeback_Type__c )), NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.PaymentMethodValidations__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a charge back type for Cancelled Payments
